- Unblocks: jido-07x.14 (U14) — Port core Plugin and persistence examples must be complete.

## Files

Read split core `examples/04_runtime/**`, `05_multi_agent/**`, `07_topology/**`, and matching tests at the core baseline. Add `examples/runtime/**`, `examples/topology/**`, and matching tests. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Port supported runtime, multi-Agent, and topology examples.
2. Preserve scheduling, timers, Bus delivery, observation, trace, recovery, requests, Turn control, children, connections, and topology mutation checks.
3. Keep peer-dependent examples tagged `:peer`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every source example in the three groups has a manifest disposition.
- [ ] Runtime ordering uses barriers or monitors.
- [ ] Peer examples do not run under default `mix test`.

## Verification

- `mix test.examples test/examples/runtime test/examples/topology` and `mix test.peer` exit with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.
